title: Which Road Is Steeper? Slope Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
Two roads climb the same hill. One rises 3 metres for every 10 metres forward, the other rises 1 metre for every 2. Which one is steeper? Just looking is not enough: you need one number that decides. In this animated lesson for Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 9, Straight Lines) we meet that number, the slope of a line.

You will see rise and run on a ramp, then watch a line turn live on graph paper while its inclination and slope count up together: flat, rising, standing straight up where the slope is not defined, and falling with a negative slope. We build m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) step by step from two points, compare positive and negative slopes, and flat and standing lines, then find the slope and inclination of the line through (-1, 2) and (3, -2). Two pause-and-think questions, the exam trap about mixing the order of the points, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.

In this video:
0:00 Two roads, one hill
0:25 Rise and run
0:53 Live: turn the line, watch the slope
1:48 Slope from two points
2:22 Positive and negative slope
3:07 Flat line and standing line
3:36 Worked example: slope and inclination
4:13 Exam trap: keep the same order
4:42 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
5:21 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 70): Parallel and Perpendicular Lines and the Angle Between Them. Two roads that never meet, and two that cross perfectly square.
